title: Microsoft Configuration Manager (administration service REST API, Windows authentication, Read-only Analyst)
readScopes: A domain service account added as a Configuration Manager administrative user (Administration > Security > Administrative Users > Add User or Group) with the built-in security role Read-only Analyst ("Grants permissions to view all Configuration Manager objects"). It reads, with GET only, https://<SMS Provider>/AdminService/wmi/ SMS_CombinedDeviceResources, SMS_SoftwareUpdate, SMS_UpdateComplianceStatus and SMS_G_System_CI_ComplianceState. The collector runs as that account on a domain-joined Windows host that reaches the SMS Provider on port 443 and trusts its certificate; CONFIGMGR_PROVIDER is the SMS Provider's FQDN. No secret is stored.

checks.title: Each discovered device runs the Configuration Manager client
checks.scope: Every device in SMS_CombinedDeviceResources except unknown and obsolete records, from IsClient; a device without a client skips every other check.

checks.title: Each client has been active within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every client, from LastActiveTime (client health), else LastPolicyRequest; the window is --configmgr-seen-days.

checks.title: Endpoint Protection antimalware and antivirus are on
checks.scope: Every client whose antimalware Configuration Manager manages, from EPEnabled and EPAntivirusEnabled; a client with EPEnabled empty is skipped.

checks.title: Antivirus signatures updated within the last 7 days
checks.scope: Every client with Endpoint Protection status, from EPAntivirusSignatureLastUpdateDateTime; the window is --configmgr-signature-days.

checks.title: No deployed software update published more than 30 days ago is still required
checks.scope: Every client, from SMS_UpdateComplianceStatus rows with Status 2 (required) for updates where IsDeployed is true and IsExpired is false, published (DatePosted) more than --configmgr-patch-days ago. Rows with Status 0 (detection unknown) make the result skipped. A client that never reported an update scan has no row and passes; read last_seen beside it. Updates that are not deployed are not judged.

checks.title: No configuration baseline item on the client is non-compliant or in error
checks.scope: Every client, from SMS_G_System_CI_ComplianceState: ComplianceState 2 (Non-Compliant) or 4 (Error) fails, 1 (Compliant) passes; a client with no known state is skipped. It shows only what the deployed baselines test.
